description: This Java source file contains a JUnit test class for testing the ChangeLogVersionFinder functionality in the OpenMRS project, focusing on version handling and log file retrieval.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersionFinderTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for validating ChangeLogVersionFinder's behavior regarding version-based log file retrieval, snapshot and update version management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test data before each test run.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseChangeSetCombinations
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of change log combinations for each version.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotCombinations
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of snapshot change log combinations.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotFilenames
methods.description: Checks if the correct snapshot filenames are returned based on a version string.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseSnapshotVersion
methods.description: Ensures the latest snapshot version is correctly identified.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseSchemaSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest schema snapshot filename.

methods.name: shouldGetLatestLiquibaseCoreDataSnapshotFilename
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest core data snapshot filename.

methods.name: shouldGetUpdateVersionsGreaterThanOtherVersion
methods.description: Tests filtering of update versions greater than a specified version.

methods.name: shouldGetNoUpdateVersionsGreaterThanFutureVersion
methods.description: Tests behavior when no update versions exist beyond a given version.

methods.name: shouldHandleEmtpyString
methods.description: Checks that empty version strings throw appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseUpdateFileNames
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of update file names for given versions.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Validates that snapshot versions are correctly listed.

methods.name: shouldGetLiquibaseUpdateVersions
methods.description: Validates that update versions are correctly listed.

methods.name: shouldGetVersionAsDotXFromShortVersionName
methods.description: Tests conversion of short version strings to 'x' notation.

methods.name: shouldGetVersionAsDotXFromLongVersionName
methods.description: Tests conversion of long version strings to 'x' notation.

methods.name: shouldHandleNonPatternMatchingVersionName
methods.description: Ensures invalid version strings trigger exceptions.
